gbm_population_evidence.quote: Patients with biopsy proven IDH- wild type GBM or imaging defined GBM
BIO-SHORT: Hypofractionated RT for Poor-Prognosis GBM

candidate_evidence.quote: The test arms will comprise of dose escalated hypo-fractionated RT (5 fractions/10 fractions). The usage of TMZ will be standard across both arms.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Unfit for surgery and referred for direct RT
Prior administration of any systemic therapy directed against glioma (eg.Temozolomide, CCNU, Bevacizumab)

role_evidence.quote: The usage of TMZ will be standard across both arms.
with the addition of pre-treatment F-DOPA PET imaging performed according to institutional consensus protocols.

agents.drug_class_hint: 18F-fluorodopa PET tracer used for radiotherapy target delineation

source_quote.quote: Patients with biopsy proven IDH- wild type GBM or imaging defined GBM

coder_notes: Phase NA randomised radiotherapy-fractionation trial; temozolomide is given in both arms (not a registered intervention, but every patient receives it) as soc_backbone, and the only experimental variable is the radiotherapy schedule, so S6 fails with no pharmacological candidate. F-DOPA PET is part of the registered experimental radiation intervention and listed as diagnostic_agent. IDH-mutant and histone-altered gliomas are excluded (exclusion criteria), coded as eligibility rows for IDH (wildtype required where biopsied; imaging-defined GBM also allowed) and H3 alteration (histone alteration not specified as H3K27M). Treatment setting newly_diagnosed: no prior glioma-directed therapy, referred for direct RT.
